})(current, previous);

}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbochnak</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-09-16 14:55:49</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>cf7caf6fdb37f7001aa2dd3b5e96198c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Initialize KT Case Analysis</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Advanced Case Management" source="x_ket_acm">e1d11876dbfb37001aa2dd3b5e961965</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Advanced Case Management">e1d11876dbfb37001aa2dd3b5e961965</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_cf7caf6fdb37f7001aa2dd3b5e96198c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-03-29 15:51:26</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before_display</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=cf7caf6fdb37f7001aa2dd3b5e96198c"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_3adbb374dbd044501aa2dd3b5e96190b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_ket_acm_case_analysis</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_ket_acm_case_analysis">true_causeVALCHANGES^ORproposed_fixVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="true_cause" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="false" field="proposed_fix" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="true" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Roll-up True Cause and Proposed Fix</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
	try{
		var watermark = "<--- Rolled up from Advanced Case Analysis (KT) --->";
		// Get parent
		var tsk = new GlideRecord("sn_customerservice_case");
		if (tsk.get(current.parent)) {

			if (current.true_cause != "") {
				if (tsk.cause == "") {
					tsk.cause = watermark + "\n" + current.true_cause;
				} else {
					var index1 = tsk.cause.indexOf(watermark);
					if (index1 > -1) {
						var cause_stem = tsk.cause.substring(0,index1);
						cause_stem = cause_stem.replace("\n", "");
						tsk.cause = cause_stem + "\n" + watermark + "\n" + current.true_cause;
					} else {
						tsk.cause = tsk.cause + "\n" + watermark + "\n" + current.true_cause;
					}
				}
			}

			if (current.proposed_fix != "") {
				if (tsk.close_notes == "") {
					tsk.close_notes = watermark + "\n" + current.proposed_fix;
				} else {
					var index2 = tsk.close_notes.indexOf(watermark);
					if (index2 > -1) {
						var fix_stem = tsk.close_notes.substring(0,index2);
						fix_stem = fix_stem.replace("\n", "");
						tsk.close_notes = fix_stem + "\n" + watermark + "\n" + current.proposed_fix;
					} else {
						tsk.close_notes = tsk.close_notes + "\n" + watermark + "\n" + current.proposed_fix;
					}
				}
			}

			tsk.update();
		}
	}
	catch(e) {gs.addInfoMessage(e);}

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbochnak</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-10-02 23:31:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>3adbb374dbd044501aa2dd3b5e96190b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>25</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Roll-up True Cause and Proposed Fix</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Advanced Case Management" source="x_ket_acm">e1d11876dbfb37001aa2dd3b5e961965</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Advanced Case Management">e1d11876dbfb37001aa2dd3b5e961965</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_3adbb374dbd044501aa2dd3b5e96190b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2020-01-23 23:40:01</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=3adbb374dbd044501aa2dd3b5e96190b"/></record_update>
